title: Changes a Ridgecrest Advantage Member May Make to Their Own Enrollment Record
content:
The member may change the primary care provider on record, the premium payment method and the billing frequency while a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is open, and may ask for a replacement identification card at any time.

**Condition of record.** The enrollment is in a status of coverage in force, coverage in its premium grace period, or an election awaiting the CMS transaction reply when the change is recorded. The enrollment record is the authority, tested before the change is recorded and matched on the enrollment reference.

### When each change takes effect

| Change | When it takes effect |
| --- | --- |
| Primary care provider | The first day of the month after it is recorded |
| Premium payment method | From the next coverage month billed |
| Premium payment method changing to withholding from a Social Security payment | Requested of Social Security by the plan; it can take two coverage months to begin |
| Billing frequency | At the start of the next quarter |

On a plan that requires a primary care provider the enrollment is never left without one. While a change to withholding from a Social Security payment is waiting to begin, the member continues to be billed directly and is told to keep paying. On a change of billing frequency the plan never re-bills coverage months it has already billed at the old frequency.

### Replacement identification card

Reissuing an identification card costs the member the reissue fee of the plan held and is recorded by the date the replacement was mailed.

### What is not changed here

The member's name, address, Medicare identifier and entitlement dates are not changed here: they belong to the member profile and to Medicare, and a member asking to change them is told which record holds them and who can change it.
